label: ENHANCED GAMES
voice_script: The Enhanced Games promised a revolution in sport. And when 20.81 seconds flashed on screen for the 50m freestyle, it seemed they delivered a world record. But look closer. Rewind the tape. Did he actually touch? The official clock stopped *before* contact. Hand-timers caught the real finish: 21.0 to 21.1 seconds. Still fast, but nowhere near the legitimate world record of 20.88. So, what exactly is 'enhanced' here? The athletes, or the official results?

screens.subtitle: But are they pushing the truth too?

screens.text: Hold on... Did he even finish?
screens.subtitle: The clock stopped BEFORE he touched.

screens.subtitle: Real time: 21.0-21.1s. NO record.
